The Saints compete in the NCAA Division I and are members of the Metro Atlantic Athletic Conference.[2] They changed their name prior to the 1988-89 season.[3] Sponsored teams[edit] A Saints women's soccer match against Air Force in 2019 Men's sports Women's sports Basketball Basketball Baseball Golf Golf Lacrosse Lacrosse Rugby Rugby Soccer Soccer Softball Tennis Swimming Track and field Tennis Track and field Volleyball Water Polo Discontinued teams[edit] See also: Siena Saints football The Siena Saints football program ran from 1965 to 2003.
